name: AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem
statement:
theorem TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem (alpha beta : K) :
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      triality v s c =
        v.r * evalU s.phi c.q
          + v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
          + BW v.omega (wedge2 s.p c.q)
          + pairW v.omega (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi)) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      muV alpha beta s c =
        { r := evalU c.psi s.p
          z := evalU s.phi c.q
          omega := alpha • wedge2 s.p c.q
            + beta • hodgeStar (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi) }) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) =
        alpha * beta * evalU s.phi s.p * evalU c.psi c.q
          + (1 - alpha * beta) * evalU c.psi s.p * evalU s.phi c.q) ∧
    ((∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) = nS s * nC c) ↔ alpha * beta = 1)

statement:
theorem StructuredSourceCubicTheorem :
    sourceTrace (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceSpur (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceNorm (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 1 ∧
    (∀ (a : K) (x : JCoord K), sourceNorm (a • x) = a ^ 3 * sourceNorm x) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K,
      sourceTraceForm x y =
        x.d1 * y.d1 + x.d2 * y.d2 + x.d3 * y.d3
          + BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K, (∀ y : JCoord K, sourceTraceForm x y = 0) → x = 0) ∧
    (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
      sourceTrace (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 + d2 + d3 ∧
      sourceSpur (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 + d1 * d3 + d2 * d3 ∧
      sourceNorm (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 * d3) ∧
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      sourceTrace (offDiagonal v s c) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (offDiagonal v s c) = -nV v - nS s - nC c ∧
      sourceNorm (offDiagonal v s c) = triality v s c)

          d3 := x.d3 ^ 2 + nV x.v + nS x.s
          v := (x.d2 + x.d3) • x.v + normalizedMuV x.s x.c
          s := (x.d1 + x.d3) • x.s + sourceMuS x.c x.v
          c := (x.d1 + x.d2) • x.c + sourceMuC x.v x.s }) ∧
    (∀ M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K, exteriorQ Mᵀ = exteriorQ M) ∧
    (∀ (alpha beta : K), alpha * beta = 1 →
      ∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
        uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
          exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
            - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
            - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2) ∧
    (∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
      normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 =
        exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
          - deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2)

    uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =

          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 3
        + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 1 *
          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 2
        + alpha * beta *
          ((momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 0 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 2
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 2 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 0
            + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 1 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 3
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 3 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 1)

        - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2

      Matrix.det (X0 s) = s.Delta ∧

      Matrix.det (A0 (rootSwap s)) = s.Delta ∧

      DeltaStar s ^ 2 - Sb s * DeltaStar s + Matrix.det s.M = 0

theorem ChartResidualBaseSourceAutClassification
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hbranch : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠
      deltaStar (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    let P := residualPairOfChart x
    let Pswap := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
    let xswap := chartWithResidualPair x Pswap
    residualPairOfChart xswap = Pswap ∧
      ∀ Q : ResidualPair K, ResidualOpen Q →
        (sameResidualBase P Q ↔
          SourceAutRelated x Q ∨ SourceAutRelated xswap Q) ∧
        ¬ (SourceAutRelated x Q ∧ SourceAutRelated xswap Q)

statement:
theorem trace_prod_blocks (L : M × N →ₗ[K] M × N) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × N) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M N))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.snd K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inr K M N)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.BlockTrace.trace_prod_three_blocks
statement:
theorem trace_prod_three_blocks
    {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module K P] [FiniteDimensional K P]
    (L : M × (N × P) →ₗ[K] M × (N × P)) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × (N × P)) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M (N × P)).comp
            (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M (N × P)))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.fst K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inl K N P))))) +
        LinearMap.trace K P
          ((LinearMap.snd K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inr K N P)))))

    (hblock' : ∀ i, a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u' i) * hat (v' i)))
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (a i) = 1)
    (hadj : ∀ i, Matrix.adjugate (a i) ≠ 0)
    (hsumu : ThreeSumZero u) (hsumu' : ThreeSumZero u')
    (hsumv : ThreeSumZero v) (hsumv' : ThreeSumZero v')
    (hrankTwo :

      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0)) :

statement:
theorem reconstructed_determinant_numerator (p q r s d : K) :
    (s * d - nu p q r s d) * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d -
      (d * nu p q r s d + q * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) *
        (d * nu p q r s d + r * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) -
      d * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d =
        -(d * (d - 1)) * pairQuadratic p q r s d

theorem nu_mul_delta (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    let p := overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    nu p q r s d * delta a b c d = d * (d - 1)

          (b-d)/delta a b c d, (c-a)/delta a b c d;
         (c-d)/delta a b c d,
          a*(d-1)/delta a b c d, b*(1-c)/delta a b c d;
         (b-a)/delta a b c d,
          c*(1-b)/delta a b c d, d*(a-1)/delta a b c d]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.reconstruct_entries
statement:
theorem reconstruct_entries (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0)
    (hnu : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d ≠ 0) :
    let p := overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    let χ := d * (d - 1) / nu p q r s d
    a = s * d / nu p q r s d ∧ b = d + q * χ ∧ c = d + r * χ

    (hf : ∀ {U V}, FullRelated U V → f U = f V) :
    let X₀ := chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1
    let X₁ := chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open)
